scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and covers both scalar fields. Finite ramp checks are supplemental, not substitutes for uniform convergence and absolute summability.
scientific_limitations: Strict positivity of all functional coefficients and ||c||_1<A are required. Distance and nowhere-density concern only the fixed-weight graph family. No conclusion about density of QNA in all bounded operators is asserted. Originality is best-of-knowledge.
title: A zero-frequency criterion for quasi norm attainment of convolution graphs on \(c_0\)
